title: Rav Kahana son of Rav Natan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.60b.13); Hyman infers from the passage that he lived in Rav Ashi’s time and suggests that the reading should be Rav Huna son of Rav Natan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rav Ashi’s explanation in the saved William Davidson Yevamot 60b passage gives context for Hyman’s chronological inference; it does not itself prove a direct exchange or the proposed replacement of Kahana with Huna son of Rav Natan.

The Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2302&lang=en) name Rav Kahana son of Rav Natan. Rav Ashi’s explanation follows a question raised by the Gemara, rather than a question explicitly attributed to Kahana. Hyman infers a chronology and proposes Rav Huna in his place.
